convert_turn_to_phase: convert a webdip turn number and subphase string into a dipcc phase string like S1901M
convert_phase_to_turn: convert a dipcc phase string like F1902R back into its corresponding webdip turn number
extract_phase_type: extract the human-readable phase type like Diplomacy Retreats or Builds from a dipcc phase string
review_turn_to_phase: review the turn_to_phase function to understand how it handles Pre-game Unknown and Finished subphase edge cases
test_phase_conversions: test the round-trip conversion between webdip turn subphase pairs and dipcc phase strings for correctness
